image_description: A white, two-seater electric golf cart parked on an asphalt surface. The vehicle features a white hardtop roof, beige interior seating, and a black rear cargo rack structure. A person is visible in the driver's seat, though their form appears distorted and fused with the steering wheel. In the background, there is a chain-link fence, grass, and another dark-colored vehicle.

The steering wheel lacks a defined rim and hub structure; it appears as a vague, melted shape rather than a rigid mechanical part.
The dark vehicle in the background has slightly warped geometry and inconsistent reflections, suggesting minor generation artifacts in secondary objects.
The vertical pillars supporting the roof show slight bending and inconsistent thickness, deviating from the expected rigid straight lines of a metal frame.
